name: Read me
description: An open book as a 1-bit Kare-style icon: black outlines on white pages, words as runs of black pixels, checker-dithered grey for the cover, a hard black drop shadow and the arrow pointer resting on a page.
choices: Black and white only: every grey is a dither, and the shadow is a hard offset with no blur
Each icon pixel is exactly two screen pixels at the native 203 × 74 size, so the bitmap stays crisp
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
